name: obelinf
description: MCP server for Obelinf, the network and infrastructure documentation platform. Query and update sites, racks, devices, subnets, IPs, VLANs, VRFs, cables, MAC addresses, and contacts from Cursor, Claude, or any MCP client over Streamable HTTP.

OBELINF_API_KEY.title: Obelinf API key
OBELINF_API_KEY.description: Scoped API key from Dashboard → API Keys. Use Read Only for safe exploration and Full Access for writes. Shown only once at creation.
